clues: This village sits in the far northwest of Bulgaria. It is the heart of its own small local area.
Winters here turn cool, but summers turn hot. The hottest day ever logged reached over 45 degrees, a true record high.
A new school that was not run by a church opened here in 1845, when Ivan Kulin was mayor.
A priest born here fought in a 1923 uprising and was hanged for it. A poem later told of his deeds.
Its old church of Saint Paraskeva was built in 1859. Its carved screen was made by masters from Debar.
